strengths: Comprehensive coverage of key architectural paradigms (TreeRAG, Contextual RAG, G‑MemLLM)

Up‑to‑date references spanning academic papers, industry reports, and practical demos
Explicit comparison of accuracy, latency, and cost with a use‑case suitability matrix
weaknesses: Several performance claims lack direct citation or quantitative backing
Operational cost figures are largely inferred rather than empirically reported
Limited discussion of multimodal or memory‑driven RAG beyond G‑MemLLM

suggestions: Include concrete benchmark numbers (e.g., latency in ms, cost per token) from end‑to‑end experiments
